title: StoopidCraft
description:
A very stoopid modpack!

Add visual and performance enhancements, practical functions, and some other useful stuff.
body:
# A very stoopid modpack!

### What is this?
This is the StoopidCraft modpack! A collection of things that I thought was cool or stupid enough to play with. It's primary purpose was to make life easier for friends joining in on a private server, but it also includes all mods to replicate the same experience on a singleplayer world.

_Now, why should you get this?_


### Better efficency and performance
Included are mods like DynamicFPS, Lithium, and more. All of these things combined into one modpack will help boost performace. Doesn't matter if you're running on a Potato or NASA supercomputers, everyone likes a smoother game.


### Eye candies built in
The visuals have also been refined. With the inclusion of things like LambDynamicLights, texture packs Faithful, and the BSL shader pack, it'll help make your game look that much better. There's also a dark theme built in, which is also nice to have.


### Brings the game to life
Minecraft right now is a bit... flat. Literally. Now, it'll make youe experience and playthrough a bit nicer to run through. Minecraft Comes Alive is a big one, giving villagers a brain. There's also more animations, 3d-Skin-Layers, and Ray's 3D Ladders and Rails.


### Adds practical (and less practical but still cool) features
If you do try to join multiplayer servers (see Compatability), you'll atleast have peace of mind that you probably won't get your acconut banned with No Chat Reports looking out for you. Speaking of looking out, Xaero's Mini/World Maps and Zoomify help you explore your surroundings, and WTHIT can quickly tell you what the hell you're looking at. 


### What about storage?
That's covered, too! With Tom's Simple Storage mods, you can create a somewhat simple storage system to store your stuff.


### Backups
Fear you might accidently delete a world? Fear not! Just, remember to configure backups beforehand and you'll be good to go.


### Somewhat Optifine compatable
Chances are, if Optifine is listed as a dependency for something, it'll work fine here anyways.


### Made with love and QuiltMC
This modpack is powered by [QuiltMC](https://quiltmc.org/en/), a fork of Fabric. If you want to change things up, and throw more mods into the mix, there's a good chance your favorite Fabric mods will work just fine, and you also get QuiltMC mods, too!

## Notes
### Compatability
As mentioned before, this was made for a specific server and/or singleplayer mode. There's no guarantee that this modpack will work as expected on other servers that weren't made specifially for this, and you may get booted off or banned if you try joining from a modded client.
